{{Quote|Out of the Doom Pipes, and coming into the Dust Gaps on the second lap, Maxus holds the lead, but Ahsoka Tano is right on his tail with Raido close behind! It's going to be a tight finish!|Droid race commentator|<ref name="CC" />}}
'''Raido''' was a [[Devlikk/Legends|Devlikk]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who flew a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[J930 Dash-8 engine|J930 ''Dash-8'']] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Raido participated in a qualifying race for the [[Mon Gazza Maze/Legends|Mon Gazza Maze]] course located on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]]. Before the [[Podracing/Legends|race]] began, the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] Podracer [[San Maxus]] paid off Raido to knock out a competitor, the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] Podracer [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who was actually a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] in disguise. Raido tailed Tano for the majority of the following race and was successful in obliterating her Podracer, though he wrecked his own pod in the process. However, Raido's efforts were ultimately wasted, as Tano obtained a spare Podracer for the next race.

==Biography==
===Conspiring with Maxus===
{{Quote|Watch it, Ahsoka&hellip; That racer in third has been shadowing you the whole race. He's coming behind you fast.|Anakin Skywalker, warning Ahsoka Tano of Raido|<ref name="CC" />}}
[[File:RaidocatchingAhsoka.jpg|thumb|left|275px|Raido tailing Ahsoka Tano's podracer in his own]]
A [[Devlikk/Legends|Devlikk]], Raido performed as a professional [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the early part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="CC" /> between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], which began in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Piloting a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[JAK Racing]] [[J930 Dash-8 engine|J930 ''Dash-8'']] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]],<ref name="CC" /> a vehicle known for its high traction ratings,<ref name="Nint">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer Official Nintendo Player's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'' Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]</ref> he participated in a [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] on the<ref name="CC" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]]&mdash;the second qualifier for a race being held on the course known as the [[Mon Gazza Maze/Legends|Mon Gazza Maze]].<ref name="CC" />

During the first qualifying race, Raido remained in the Podracer [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], inspecting his vehicle alongside the [[Toong/Legends|Toong]] pilot [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]], though both were momentarily distracted by the arrival of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Skywalker's [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], was also preparing to enter the second qualifying race, going undercover as a pilot in order to uncover [[Spy/Legends|spies]] working for the Confederacy. One of the Confederate spies was the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] male pilot [[San Maxus]]. Maxus caught onto the Jedi, however, and sought out Raido. Maxus ended up hiring the Devlikk Podracer to knock Tano out of the race.<ref name="CC" />

===Carrying out the plan===
[[File:Raido_collides_with_Tano.png|thumb|right|275px|Raido collided with Ahsoka Tano on the behalf of San Maxus.]]
As the second qualifying race began, Tano managed to stay up in front with the leaders, shadowing Maxus for most of the race. Raido, in turn, followed closely behind Tano. Pilots crashed as the race course became increasingly hazardous, but the three leaders remained in their positions&mdash;as eagerly announced by the race's [[Unidentified droid race announcer|droid commentator]] when the pilots made it through a portion of the track known as the [[Doom Pipes]] and headed to the final stretch of the course, the [[Dust Gaps]]. Tano suddenly fell behind, ending up in the rear of the pack moments before she reached the finish line. Raido followed suit, remaining behind her as opposed to surging ahead. Skywalker, noting the turn of events, warned Tano through a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to watch out for Raido's yellow ''Dash''-8 tailing her. However, as the finish line drew closer, Raido finally made his move against Tano and accelerated to rear-end her [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]].<ref name="CC" />

The move proved to be successful&mdash;at first. Tano's racer was destroyed, crossing the finish line in pieces. Raido, however, was unable to regain control of his Podracer and crashed right behind Tano. The pilots skidded across the finish line, with Tano finishing in tenth and Raido in eleventh. While Maxus was pleased that Tano no longer had a Pod to race in, he was subsequently angered by the action of his friend and crew leader, [[Kidd Kareen]], who, having taken a liking to the young Togruta girl, offered Tano one of his spare Podracers to compete with for the Maze. During the following Maze race, Maxus attempted to make a delivery to the Confederate agent [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], but the Devaronian crashed after Tano damaged his Podracer.<ref name="CC" />

==Personality and traits==
Raido was a skilled pilot, with the sharp reflexes one needed to pursue a career like Podracing, and was able to tail Ahsoka Tano at varying speeds for the entirety of their race together. Raido was also not above accepting bribes to demolish the competition and accepted such an assignment from San Maxus.<ref name="CC" />

A Devlikk, he was covered in short, tan [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and had green plumage that topped his head and ringed his neck. Raido also had black-colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown skin.<ref name="CC" />

==Equipment==
[[File:RaidoPodracer-CrashCourse.png|thumb|right|185px|Raido piloted a yellow J930 ''Dash-8''.]]
Raido favored a JAK Racing J930 ''Dash-8'' Podracer,<ref name="CC" /> a vehicle that was well known for its high traction ratings and also renowned for its maneuverability and speed. However, the vehicle lacked durability,<ref name="Nint" /> as proven by Raido's ill-fated attempt to knock out competitor Ahsoka Tano from their race on Mon Gazza. Raido's Podracer's color scheme was yellow with some black detailing on the [[Engine/Legends|engine]] fins and on the engine housing itself. The cockpit was uniformly yellow, while the seat cushioning inside the cockpit was orange.<ref name="CC" />

When racing, Raido protected his eyes with a pair of brown [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] with black straps that wrapped around his head.<ref name="CC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Raido was created by [[Henry Gilroy]] and appeared in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars comic books|graphic novella]] ''[[The Clone Wars: Crash Course]]'', in which he was illustrated by [[Matthew Fillbach|Matthew]] and [[Shawn Fillbach]].<ref name="CC" /> The [[2012]] publication ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' later mentioned a [[City/Legends|city]] named [[New Raido]], which, according to [[Daniel Wallace]], the writer of ''Book of Sith'', was intended as a reference to the Podracer Raido. In the endnotes to ''Book of Sith'', Wallace suggested that the name "Raido" may have seen common usage among the Devlikk and could be linked back to a famous historical figure from among their [[Species/Legends|species]], after whom both the Podracer pilot and the city were named.<ref name="ENBOS">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/03/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith_15.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 2)|date=2012-03-15}}</ref>
